photos.title: Beyond the Surface
photos.desc: What the camera catches is never the whole person. This one gets close.

photos.title: Blinded by the Spotlight
photos.desc: When the light is too much and not enough at the same time.

photos.title: Chaos of Desires
photos.desc: Wanting too many things at once. The face rarely lies about that.

photos.title: Limitations
photos.desc: Every frame is a limit. Every limit is a choice.

photos.title: Mysteries Untold
photos.desc: Some things the subject keeps. The photograph holds the space around them.

photos.title: Petra
photos.desc: A portrait named for the person in it. Sometimes that is enough.

photos.title: Preparation
photos.desc: Before the moment, there is always this — the getting ready.

photos.title: Solace
photos.desc: Quiet comfort, visible in the body even when the face is still.

photos.title: Vicky
photos.desc: A portrait of Vicky. The name says more than any description could.

photos.title: In the Red
photos.desc: The hours that are not gold or blue but red — urgent, heated, unmistakable.

photos.title: Somewhere Else
photos.desc: Far enough to see clearly. Close enough to feel it.

photos.title: The Burden of Awareness
photos.desc: Two people. The space between them holds everything unsaid.

photos.title: Hands Pressed
photos.desc: The moment of gathering oneself before speaking to something larger.

photos.title: The Language of Stillness
photos.desc: Present in the same frame. Somewhere else entirely in the mind.

photos.title: The Crown
photos.desc: Worn or implied — the crown is in the posture, in the gaze.

photos.title: The Sun Found Her
photos.desc: The wind does not hold — it moves. But in this frame, it paused.

photos.title: The Gele
photos.desc: Ghana's light as fabric. Worn, draped, impossible to buy.

photos.title: Split
photos.desc: Some faces stay. This one did.

photos.title: The Still Woman
photos.desc: An internal accounting. Nothing announced, everything considered.

photos.title: Two of the Same
photos.desc: The shadow tells the story the light refused to touch.

photos.title: Before He Looked Up
photos.desc: Not the hours of crisis — the hours that simply weigh more than others.

photos.title: Folded
photos.desc: Silence is not nothing. This image knows that.

photos.title: The Gaze
photos.desc: Something carried from before — a warmth that persists regardless of the temperature.

photos.title: Mid-Thought
photos.desc: Between full illumination and full shadow. The most honest place to photograph a face.

photos.title: Holding On
photos.desc: One hour in the day when everything slows. This is that hour, preserved.

photos.title: Something Caught His Attention
photos.desc: After everything else passes. What is left is always worth photographing.

photos.title: Made of...
photos.desc: Not extinguished. Just burning at the right intensity for what is required.

photos.title: Offstage
photos.desc: The words that stayed inside. The photograph catches what the voice could not say.

photos.title: Delving Deep
photos.desc: Not every frame needs to be full. Some of the best portraits leave space.

photos.title: Edge of Gold
photos.desc: Drifting is not aimless when the light is this good.

photos.title: You Were in the Way
photos.desc: Facing away is a kind of portrait. The back tells things the face hides.

photos.title: Washed Out
photos.desc: Leaving without a label. Some exits are felt, not explained.

photos.title: Looking Past It All
photos.desc: Looking up — at light, at possibility, at something just out of frame.
